question: Should generic tool-progress intent be a supported public Plugin SDK reply-payload contract, or remain internal to bundled producers and channel delivery?
rationale: The Slack block-path defect has a mechanical repair, but code review cannot decide whether external plugins should permanently depend on these new SDK symbols.

options.title: Approve the public contract
options.body: Keep the generic constant and predicate as supported Plugin SDK API after repairing the Slack block path and adding compatibility coverage.

options.title: Keep it internal
options.body: Remove the public exports and route typed progress intent through an internal bundled-runtime contract.

recommendation.title: Approve the public contract
recommendation.body: Keep the generic constant and predicate as supported Plugin SDK API after repairing the Slack block path and adding compatibility coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged work spans both the shared reply-payload surface and the Codex producer path, making them the best available owner for the API-boundary decision.
